title: %minOf — minimum of scalar arguments
purpose: Return the smallest of two or more scalar numeric arguments.
notes: Variadic: pass each operand as a separate scalar argument.
This is not an array-reducing verb — to take the minimum of an array, fan its elements out as individual references.

avoid.why: %minOf compares its scalar arguments; passing a single array reference coerces the array to its length, not its minimum element
